subject: Upfront credit and bundle structure for Clearline pilot
messages:
From: Elaine Tucker <elaine.tucker@clearline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Jan 2027 15:05:00 -0500
Subject: Intro: pricing request + migration credit for Clearline evaluation

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the readiness to support our SSO/KMS needs. We're putting together a short pilot to validate end-to-end inferencing and embeddings for our analytics UIs. Two things we need from Redwood to make the procurement case:

- A clear pricing comparison versus our incumbent (ModelBank) that shows the effective per-token rate after any credits or bundles.
- A one-time migration/onboarding credit to cover initial conversion costs (we typically see ~2–3 weeks of engineering time).

Attached is the RFP and a rough usage estimate (Clearline_RFP_Q1.xlsx). Our procurement lead (procurement@clearline.com) suggested anchoring on a 12-month commit if we can get an upfront credit and volumetric discounts.

Can you send a short proposal and a sample net-effective calculation (per-token) that includes how embeddings are billed vs generation? We need something we can show to the finance review on Jan 18.

Thanks,
Elaine Tucker
Director, Platform Strategy
Clearline Analytics

--
Attachment: Clearline_RFP_Q1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Tucker <elaine.tucker@clearline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: pricing request + migration credit for Clearline evaluation

Hi Elaine — great to hear the demo landed well. I've attached an initial proposal (Redwood_Proposal_Q1_2027.pdf) with two commitment options: 6-month pilot commit and 12-month committed bundle. High level:

- Upfront migration credit: we can make a one-time credit applied against first invoice; size scales with committed ARR (see table in proposal).
- Volume discounts: tiered per-token price reductions that kick in at monthly consumption thresholds; embeddings billed per 1k vectors with an explicit effective-rate example in the appendix.
- Bundling: option to include a fixed monthly embedding allotment (pre-bundled) plus overage pricing, or to use pure pay-as-you-go with a larger upfront credit.

To be transparent, any migration credit is conditioned on a 12-month minimum commitment to guarantee unit economics for Redwood; for pilots we can do a smaller, time-limited credit and a 30–60 day evaluation window.

Next steps: if you can confirm the expected average monthly token volume (rough ballpark is fine) and whether you prefer an embedding bundle or usage billing, I will have Karthik draft the commercial terms and Marissa run a quick finance sign-off. Can we schedule a 30-min pricing call tomorrow (Jan 11)?

Thanks — looping Marissa and Karthik for the commercial details.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: Redwood_Proposal_Q1_2027.pdf (proposal PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Tucker <elaine.tucker@clearline.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: pricing request + migration credit for Clearline evaluation

Hi Elaine — quick note from finance/commercials:

We are prepared to offer the following structure for a 12-month commitment:

- Migration credit: one-time credit equal to 10% of first-year committed spend, applied to invoice #1.
- Volume discounts: 12% off list at >10M tokens/month, 20% at >50M tokens/month (these are examples; we will model exact effective rates once we have expected volumes).
- Embeddings: two options — (A) bundle 1M vectors/month at a flat monthly fee, overage at $0.003/vector; (B) usage-based at $0.004/vector with a 10% discount applied to the embeddings line for 12-month deals.
- Private deployment add-on: note that Private (VPC/on-prem) costs and infra are excluded from the above credits and require separate sizing/quote.

We need confirmation of expected monthly breakdowns: generation tokens vs embedding vectors, and whether you'll need Private deployment. Once we have that, we'll compute a net-effective per-token and provide a revised DocuSign-ready quote and SOW.

If this looks OK, I'll prepare a negotiated quote with two scenario sheets (6-month pilot + 12-month commit) and share it today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

--

From: Elaine Tucker <elaine.tucker@clearline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clearline Procurement <procurement@clearline.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:26:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro: pricing request + migration credit for Clearline evaluation

Thanks — this is helpful and closer to what our procurement team needs. A few clarifications before we finalize:

- Monthly volumes: estimate 18M gen tokens and 750k embedding vectors in steady-state after pilot. During the pilot we expect ~4–5M gen tokens.
- Bundle preference: we prefer the embedding bundle option (A) to avoid variable spikes during the pilot.
- Private deployment: not required for pilot; we may revisit later.

Could you send the net-effective rate calculation that folds in the 10% migration credit and the 12% volume discount tier at our expected volumes? Also include the SOW for the pilot (deliverables + milestones) — procurement needs it to open a PO. I've attached updated usage estimates (Clearline_usage_estimates.csv).

If you can share a DocuSign link for the 12-month quote and SOW, we can begin review on Jan 12.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elaine
Director, Platform Strategy
Clearline Analytics

--
Attachment: Clearline_usage_estimates.csv (CSV)
